{{short description|American mathematician}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=July 2025}}
'''David Eugene Barrett''' is a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Michigan]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.math.lsa.umich.edu/~barrett/|title=Index}}</ref>

Barrett received his Ph.D. from the [[University of Chicago]] in 1982 under the supervision of [[Raghavan Narasimhan]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=7571|title=David Barrett}}</ref>

In 2012, Barrett became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society]</ref>
